personality_one_liner: An operational command-center mobile app for cybersecurity blue team analysts featuring real-time triage, traffic-light log classification, and incident reports with human review.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical padding, single-column security cards with consistent 16px margins, sticky action bottom bar with glass effect.

do's: Apply translucent frosted glass to sticky bottom nav and incident action headers
Ensure solid 80% tint on glass surfaces over scrolling logs
dont's: Never blur body text or interactive IOC input fields
Avoid glass overlays on dense traffic light log tables

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Corporate SSO/Google or email/senha authentication with secure session state

states.error: Authentication failed. Verify token or password.

screens.layout: Centered secure card layout with biometric toggle and corporate login button.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of active SOC incidents, severity distribution, and rapid alert queues

states.empty: No active incidents reported in perimeter.
states.error: Failed to poll SIEM aggregator. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Scrollable metrics grid, high-priority incident cards, and quick action toolbar.

screens.name: Incident Triage
screens.purpose: Detailed incident analysis with traffic-light log classification (Green/Yellow/Red)

states.loading: Parsing event logs and running heuristic checks...
states.error: Log parse error. Check syntax and retry.

screens.layout: Interactive log viewer with color-coded severity badges and human review sign-off panel.

screens.name: Checklist & IOCs
screens.purpose: Step-by-step incident response playbook and fast lookup for Indicators of Compromise

states.empty: No IOCs registered for this incident.
states.error: Threat feed offline. Using local cache.

screens.layout: Tabbed workspace with interactive checklist items and instant IOC search bar.

screens.name: Evidence & Reports
screens.purpose: Secure evidence logging, analyst notes, and editable incident report generation with human review
screens.layout: Timeline view of evidence with Markdown notes and editable report preview.

screens.name: Cyber Library
screens.purpose: Educational cybersecurity modules, adversary tactics, and mitigation playbooks for review
screens.layout: Card-based learning modules with search filter and bookmarking.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Theme toggle (dark SOC vs light mode), API integrations, and notification preferences
screens.layout: Structured settings list with theme switcher and integration status indicators.

soc_hero.alt: SOC command center dashboard dark interface

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all screens adhere to the Dark-First Utility theme with cobalt/blue accents (#3B82F6) and high-contrast accessibility. All log classifications must use the green/yellow/red traffic light indicator. Incident reports require explicit manual analyst review before export. Support theme toggle between dark SOC mode and light mode.
